description: Did this USDC payment actually settle on Base? Give a tx hash; get success, confirmations, and the USDC transfers, optionally checked against an expected recipient and amount. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: POST https://api.firstmention.uk/s/x402index/verify

expect_amount_usdc.description: Optional minimum USDC amount to require

expect_to.description: Optional recipient address to require among USDC transfers

tx_hash.description: 0x + 64 hex chars transaction hash on Base

name: x402index__verify
